meaning: Heat pump blocked: Bosch says E21 means the dishwasher's heat pump is blocked.
causes: A blocked heat pump, the cause Bosch gives
diySteps: Reset power at the breaker: switch it off for 30 seconds, then back on
If E21 is not resolved, call Bosch Customer Support (1-800-944-2904) with your model number ready
safetyNote: Switch the dishwasher off at its breaker before you reach into the base or remove a filter or cover, and let the tub and water cool after a cycle. Watch for sharp debris. Pump, heater, valve and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: If the 30-second breaker reset does not clear E21, Bosch says to call Customer Support. Bosch lists other heat pump codes separately: E01 (heat pump motor circuit fault at the main control board), E09 and E20 (heat pump internal heater fault) and E12 (limescale build-up in the heat pump, which is fixed by descaling).
sourceTitle: Bosch Dishwasher Error Codes: Troubleshooting Guide (Bosch)
